newsitem.title: UK: Fannie Mae says FRF global bond possible.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae says FRF global bond possible.

text.p: Fannie Mae treasurer Linda Knight told Reuters on Wedensday a French franc global bond was still a possibility.
"The French franc deal could easily still come," Knight said.
Fannie Mae held a series of roadshows for such a deal in November last year.
Fannie Mae on Wednesday priced a 1.0 billion stg global bond due June 2002.
Knight said the reason the French franc global deal had not yet been launched was that it was unable to align both the issuing market and the swap market.
"There was a great deal of interest from institutional investors for our paper, but we were unable to make it work economically."
